title: Equipment Fit Restrictions by Schedule, PAP Supply Replenishment Program
content:
Three fit restrictions of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program are switched on or off by resupply schedule: whether an interface of a different style inside the current interface period is not covered, whether heated and standard tubing are mutually exclusive within one period, and whether a water chamber ships only to patients using a heated humidifier.

| Schedule | Interface of a different style inside the current interface period not covered | Heated and standard tubing mutually exclusive within one period | Water chamber only for a patient using a heated humidifier |
|---|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Resupply Schedule | yes | yes | yes |
| Medicare Advantage Resupply Schedule | yes | yes | yes |
| Medicaid Resupply Schedule | yes | yes | yes |
| Commercial HMO Resupply Schedule | yes | yes | yes |
| Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule | no | yes | yes |
| Self-Pay Supply Subscription | no | no | no |

## Reading the chart

- Every coverage schedule keeps heated tubing and standard tubing apart within one period, and every coverage schedule ships a water chamber only to a patient using a heated humidifier.
- The style-change restriction on interfaces is on for the Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage, Medicaid and Commercial HMO schedules and off for the Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule.
- The Self-Pay Supply Subscription switches all three restrictions off.
